messages:
deploy-bot: Canary health check failed for payments-service chart=payments-chart image.tag=v3.2.0 in eu-west-1. Staged promote halted at 10% traffic. Reason: readinessProbe failures -> pod CrashLoopBackOff. Requesting rollback vs hotpatch decision from eng-releases.

maria: On it — checking pod logs and recent chart changes.

josh: quick skim of logs shows OOMKilled during migration job startup, then readiness flapping.

sre-oncall: Is this the migration we added in the chart values? Could be concurrency spike. My vote: rollback canary and pin previous known-good version until we patch. Change window is still open.

maria: I see the chart bumped default `migration.concurrency` to 4 and increased DB pool size. If migrations run busy we might exhaust memory. Agree to rollback.

product-ops: Any visible customer impact? Are payments failing or just retries?

josh: Error rate on payments spike ~3.2% for the canary cohort, most requests eventually succeed on retry. No DB corruption reported.

maria: Proposed plan: 1) rollback canary subset to v3.1.7 and pin it 2) open quick hotfix PR to reduce migration.concurrency and add feature flag 3) hold promotion until patch merged + smoke tests.

sre-oncall: I'll run the rollback for the canary portion now and create a lock. Command I'll run:
```
helm upgrade --install payments-service payments-chart --namespace prod \
  --set image.tag=v3.1.7 \
  --set traffic.split=0.10 \
  --reuse-values
```
I'll also create a deploy lock: payments-service@v3.1.7

josh: Also request deploy-bot to block staged promotes for payments-service until we remove the lock. @deploy-bot create pin v3.1.7

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Created lock: `payments-service@v3.1.7` (reason: canary readiness failures). Staged promotes halted. Lock link: https://deploy/locks/12345

maria: :thumbsup: I'll draft release note and a short postmortem stub: "Rollback payments-service canary due to readiness failures caused by migration concurrency and memory pressure. Pin v3.1.7 while patch applied."

product-ops: Can we schedule a 15m sync after rollback completes to confirm impact and align on user communication?

sre-oncall: Scheduled 15m post-rollback check. Rollback executed on canary subset — pods stabilized, readiness back to green. Monitoring for 10m.

josh: After we patch, let's promote with a very small traffic fraction first (0.5%) and a migration-safe toggle: `migration.enabled=true, migration.concurrency=1` in overlay values.

maria: Opening PR with chart patch + explicit migration flag and updated default values. PR: https://git/repo/pulls/456 — will add release notes and testing checklist.

deploy-bot: Event log: rollback-complete, lock-created, postmortem-scheduled. No further staged promotions will occur for this service until lock cleared.

sre-oncall: Verified error rates back to baseline for the canary cohort. I'll close monitoring after 10 more minutes unless anyone objects.

maria: No objections. I'll coordinate patch release notes and the follow-up staged promote checklist.

deploy-bot: Closing thread when stable."
